candidates.title: Apple Unveils Rebuilt Siri Powered by Google Gemini and CEO Succession at WWDC 2026
candidates.description: At WWDC 2026, Apple announced a complete overhaul of Siri, partnering with Google to license a custom 1.2-trillion-parameter Gemini model for $1 billion annually. Apple also announced that Tim Cook will step down as CEO on September 1, 2026, to be succeeded by hardware engineering head John Ternus.
candidates.significance: This marks a massive shift in the consumer AI landscape, representing a historic partnership between long-term rivals Apple and Google, a transition to agentic on-device AI, and the end of Tim Cook's 15-year tenure as Apple CEO.

candidates.title: Google Partners with SpaceX for Colossus Data Center Capacity
candidates.description: Google signed a milestone deal with SpaceX to utilize its Colossus data center to handle overflow compute capacity for Gemini Enterprise. The agreement highlights the extreme scaling demands and infrastructure constraints faced by frontier AI developers.
candidates.significance: Secures critical non-traditional infrastructure pathways for frontier AI compute scaling, reflecting the intense competition and physical capacity constraints in AI data center hosting.

candidates.title: Sovereign Wealth Fund Act Proposed for US Public Share in Frontier AI
candidates.description: U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders introduced the 'American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act,' proposing a 50% one-time stock-based tax on leading private AI companies—including OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI—to establish a public wealth fund. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman expressed openness to public equity concepts.
candidates.significance: Represents a historic, high-stakes legislative proposal to transition a portion of private AI capital gains to the public sector, sparking debate on public ownership of frontier AI technologies.

candidates.title: NVIDIA, SK hynix, and SK Telecom Partner on Rubin AI Supercomputer Memory and Giga-Scale Cloud
candidates.description: NVIDIA and SK hynix established a multiyear partnership to co-develop next-generation memory for NVIDIA's upcoming Vera Rubin AI supercomputer architecture and Jetson Thor robotics platform. Concurrently, SK Telecom announced a gigawatt-scale AI Cloud in South Korea using NVIDIA's DSX platform.
candidates.significance: Solidifies the hardware and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) supply chains necessary for next-generation frontier AI supercomputers, enabling gigawatt-scale AI data center expansions globally.
